verdict.rationale: Snyk documents a built-in 'Remediation Agent' — an LLM-driven agent that scans a project, generates and applies a fix plan, and verifies results, invocable via `snyk fix --agentic`, `/snyk-fix` in a coding assistant, or the Snyk CLI/IDE — which is a genuine built-in AI assistant users can delegate remediation tasks to, complemented by DeepCode AI-powered autofixes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that the Remediation Agent reliably completes delegated fix tasks (probes only validate the separate MCP server handshake, not the agent's actual remediation quality), and no community corroboration of this specific feature.
